title: Concept: Set-Cookie carries an unrecognised SameSite value
description: A Set-Cookie header carries a SameSite attribute whose value is not one of Strict, Lax or None, or carries the attribute without a value. Browsers discard an uninterpretable value and apply their default cross-site policy, so the cookie's cross-site behaviour is not the one the response declares.
risk: The cookie is sent under the browser default policy rather than the declared one; LOW severity because the outcome depends on the browser default.
